source_title: Mirzapur The Movie arrives on OTT with extended cut: Where to watch
source_excerpt:
Mirzapur: The Movie has begun streaming on Prime Video with an extended cut. The release offers subscribers additional footage beyond the version shown in cinemas.
The world of Mirzapur is back, and fans have a new reason to celebrate. Mirzapur: The Movie , starring Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu, is now streaming online with an extended cut that offers viewers additional content beyond the theatrical version. The film, which released in cinemas on September 4, brings back some of the franchise's most popular characters for another battle over the throne of Mirzapur.
Directed by Gurmmeet Singh, the film revisits the rivalry between Kaleen Bhaiya, Guddu Pandit and Bablu Pandit. Those who missed its theatrical release can now watch it from home. Where to watch Mirzapur: The Movie on OTT
Where to watch Mirzapur: The Movie on OTT
Mirzapur: The Movie is available to stream on Prime Video. The film can be watched in Hindi with English subtitles, and viewers need an active subscription to access it.
The OTT release also comes with an extended cut, giving fans more content than the version shown in cinemas.
Announcing the release on Instagram, Prime Video shared a poster of the film with the caption, "Bhaukaal aa chuka hai #MirzapurTheMovieOnPrime, Watch Now." Mirzapur: The Movie cast Alongside Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu, the film features Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Jitendra Kumar and Mohitt Maalik in key roles.

The returning characters and familiar power struggles bring the film back to the crime drama's central theme: the fight for control over Mirzapur..
The film recorded a strong opening at the Indian box office, according to trade tracker Sacnilk . It earned Rs 30.90 crore on its first day, followed by Rs 38.40 crore on the second day and Rs 43.05 crore on the third day. Its first-week collection stood at Rs 148.45 crore. The film's worldwide box office collection stands at Rs 339.84 crore. - Ends
